motion.reducedMotion: disable animations, transitions and smooth scrolling

rules: five-destination bottom navigation with safe-area inset
Home, detail, Settings and Imports single column
sheet padding 20px; banner and form actions wrap

fallbacks.reducedTransparency: opaque navigation; remove nav blur and standard sheet backdrop blur
fallbacks.safeArea: bottom nav and welcome footer respect env(safe-area-inset-bottom)

Sheet.name: useId heading ID referenced by aria-labelledby
Sheet.focus: native showModal; restore connected opener on cleanup
Sheet.dismissal: named close button; Escape invokes onClose
Sheet.busy: optional aria-busy; disable Close and block Escape during local approval commit; guarded approval close callback also protects same-turn window before rendering

reminders.surface: optional per-device Settings group; existing solid surfaces, system typography and semantic accent controls
reminders.controls: household time zone; explicit connect and enable; category checkboxes and distinctly named native time inputs; separate save/test/retry/disconnect actions
reminders.drafts: persist preference edits locally through offline/reload; explicit connected save applies server scheduling; no offline local notification scheduler
reminders.availability: busy disables form; offline disables server actions; unsaved or disabled preferences disable test sending; installation/unsupported/denied/setup/key-change states explain recovery
reminders.feedback: saved/queued/pending role=status; errors/key changes role=alert; Last accepted by delivery service is vendor acceptance, not proof of device display
reminders.navigation: valid notification opens calendar day or Settings; preserve active recipe editor and show role=status handoff banner with Open reminder disabled until editing finishes

planning.surface: shared Meal suggestions group on existing solid Settings surface; system typography and semantic accent controls; multi-category preview uses scrolling Sheet
planning.defaults: dinner; no repeated recipes; recipe-specific servings; available leftovers enabled
planning.controls: labelled breakfast/lunch/dinner checkboxes, repeats and leftover choices, optional labelled fixed-portions field; empty categories disable save; busy disables form
planning.drafts: per-device edits persist immediately through offline/reload separately from validated saved household snapshot; offline previews use last saved choices; refresh preserves unsaved draft; explicit online save shares settings; isolated demo stays local
planning.feedback: save success role=status reminds that plans need approval; save error role=alert explains portions/connection and retained draft
planning.preview: actual recipe title, weekday/category, portions and ranking reason; checked rows permit exclusion; zero selection disables Add to calendar; regenerate resets selection; preview generation writes no meals
planning.approval: synchronous guard blocks same-turn repeated activation; disable selection/regenerate/approval/dismissal during local commit; reread persisted local occupancy before save; server applies atomically against current calendar
planning.recovery: failure retains selection and releases guard for retry; English/German role=alert asks users to check calendar before another mix, without claiming no write occurred after a later refresh failure
planning.learning: each distinct chosen recipe increments once per successful approval in same transaction as meal writes and replay receipt; failed approvals/duplicate delivery add no learning; bounded bonus preserves variety; chosen-before explanation never implies cooking

admin.phoneNavigation: wrapping grid; static glass top region
admin.fallbacks: opaque panel when backdrop-filter unsupported or reduced transparency requested

requirements: visible focus; keyboard and screen-reader controls
EN/DE UI; preserve imported content language
scalable text and browser storage/recovery clarity

Both original peach/wordmark PNGs were received in a ZIP and installed in the PWA/console without redrawing or recolouring. Preserve the established system-type/glass visual world with the explicitly approved cream/coral/peach and cocoa/peach web palette. Native artwork is unchanged by this server release.
